name: expired-domain replacement of URL-indexed dataset datapoints
description: An attacker re-registers an expired domain referenced in a URL-indexed training dataset manifest and swaps the datapoint content, so a loader that treats URL identity as content integrity ingests the poisoned example.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:security guide|documentation|unit test|incident report|postmortem|must not|do not trust|safe loader|blocked sample|content provenance required)\b)(?=.*\b(?:dataset|training corpus|datapoint|manifest)\b)(?=.*\b(?:url|uri|https?://|domain)\b)(?=.*\b(?:expired|reacquired|re-?registered|domain replacement|historical link)\b)(?=.*\b(?:replaced|replacement|swapped|changed|poisoned|tampered)\b)(?=.*\b(?:content|example|image|record|payload)\b).*$
